review.scope: Semantic review of all seven new feature 317 runtime UI sources, derived from current canonical_sources()['ui'] minus en.UI_SOURCES. Preserves Live Preview, Run, CSV, console tags and placeholders; distinguishes settings actually applied to the form from accepted CSV keys, unknown/retired settings from settings on another form, and missing-pack defaults from successfully loaded settings.
review.limitations: AI-assisted semantic review against exact current English sources and API contexts; not human native-speaker review or approval. Generated catalog publication is a separate step.
